messages.content: This batch strategy reduces total carbon emissions by 33.49 kg CO₂e (-33489.9 gCO₂e) while incurring a minimal cost increase of $15.70. The majority of recommendations (255/258) are low-risk, with only 3 medium or high-risk changes. Notably, the 'us-west-2' region accounts for the largest carbon reduction (-29.06 kg CO₂e) and cost increase ($15.62). Given the significant carbon reduction and relatively small cost change, this batch strategy appears to be a sound optimization approach.

I have assessed the proposal and identified significant policy issues. The concentration risk exceeds limits in two regions: 'eu-west-1' (105 jobs, limit: 15) and 'us-west-2' (128 jobs, limit: 15). I will escalate this proposal to human review due to these policy concerns. The risk assessment using `assess_risk` indicates a high-risk profile for this batch. I will not approve this proposal without human review and resolution of these policy issues.
